verdict.rationale: Marqeta's docs show a broad, API-first surface covering core functions (cards, transactions, disputes, velocity/authorization controls, JIT funding, webhooks, sandbox simulations) that mirror typical dashboard operations, suggesting the API is the primary interface. However, there is no explicit documentation confirming full UI/API parity or listing any UI-only features, and no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt was found (probes 404), leaving completeness unverified. missing for 10: explicit parity statement, published OpenAPI spec, evidence of dashboard-only features being absent from API.
